implementation: A source-certified normal Q62 two-cell enclosure enables one strict integer midpoint check. Binade starts and arbitrary hints retain the old two-boundary mode. Ambiguous midpoint comparisons retain identical full refinement. Sharing lower-cell packing gives equivalent RNE outside the guarded ambiguity.

certificate.scope: Conditional on the unchanged qualified parent Q62 enclosure and integer-boundary inequalities. Proves that the trusted normal ambiguity needs one separating midpoint; arbitrary hints keep their original contract. Does not prove general pow totality, compiled ABI or device timings.

first_cell_arm.scope: Actual ARM trusted pointer+cell entry with valid adjacent cells, distant binade-start cells and aliasing; every result matches directed MPFR. Hooks at the real public-path callee verify the first-tier two-cell guarantee. Arbitrary untrusted hints are checked separately through the preserved old API. Finite tests do not prove totality or device timings.

untrusted_dyadic_arm.scope: Actual production ARM dyadic midpoint decisions checked with independently formed exact rational x^p and midpoint^q, including jittered valid input enclosures. Both exponent signs and denominator powers through128 are covered. Exact, adjacent, distant and invalid hints have no rounding authority; every accepted result matches directed MPFR. Selected full public calls check integration. This is finite coverage, not totality or physical-speed proof.

all12.oracle: Directed MPFR bounds; both endpoints round to the same binary64 (RNE).
all12.abi: Every call verifies R4-R11, SP, bounded stack writes.
all12.semantics: RNE return values; errno and floating exception flags are not implemented.
all12.nan_result_policy: NaN results must be quiet; payload and sign are unspecified.
known_limitations: An undecided owned 1024-bit pow refinement still traps; all-input totality is unproved.
all12.scope: Finite corpus, not an exhaustive proof over every binary64 input.

instruction_matrix.scope: Executed ARM instructions on the prepared finite corpus, with typed 32-bit return masking. If sides_share_elf is false, owned production symbols and pinned diagnostic Qfplib symbols run on separate instances of the same Cortex-M0 emulator. When actual_bootrom is present, SDK ROM lookup initializers, wrappers and ROM bodies execute without intrinsic models. SIO division remains functionally modeled. These are not hardware cycles, cache comparisons, timings, or proof of speed parity.

affected_corpus.oracle: Directed MPFR bounds must round to the same binary64; signaling NaNs separately require a quiet NaN result.
affected_corpus.abi: Every ARM call verifies R4-R11, SP and bounded stack writes.
affected_corpus.scope: Saved worst-case corpus; not a totality proof over all binary64 pairs.
known_limitations: The owned 512/1024-bit fallback preserves a final undecided-interval trap; totality is unproved.

resources_and_link.scope: Only the certified normal first-cell route, its compact RNE pack and a shared dyadic mode/wrapper change. Old arbitrary hints force the original two-boundary mode. Four numeric objects are identical; all other prior native object functions retain their bytes. Non-pow linked functions are identical or recursively normalized equivalent calls; only three existing RAM shifts may move. No physical cache/timing or all-input totality claim.

M4_isolation.scope: Cortex-M4 O3 release, both soft and hard float ABIs: normalized preprocessing and every allocated code/data section identical; existing M4 runtime sources byte-identical

generic_M0_isolation.scope: Non-RP2040 generic ARMv6-M: every allocated code/data section remains byte-identical to V60. The generic spelling has an extra expression macro; normalized preprocessing identity is not claimed.

cache_probe.assumptions: Same previously checked 16 KiB / two-way / 8-byte-line cache geometry; LRU/FIFO replacement and whole-line/per-word fills are explicit model assumptions. These are not claims about undocumented prefetch or replacement.
cache_probe.scope: Exact ARM instruction/data traces and exact results on the recorded finite groups per image, including every ln/log10 stream and the three difficult pow streams, with actual ROM and linked memory code. Two warm passes then a measured third pass. Only XIP accesses enter the cache model. Excludes caller prefetch, IRQs, other-core traffic and Qfplib batches. Not measured XIP counters or physical speed evidence.

selector.selection: Union of all saved entries with |y|=p/q, p<=32 and q<=128, and all new tiny-binomial dispatch gates. Selection places no restriction on base encodings and includes both exponent signs. These cover every potentially accepted new numerical path in the saved corpus; unsupported cases provably decline and remain on existing paths. Line ranges refer to the unchanged full corpus.
selector.scope: Deterministic exact binary64 exponent-domain selection, not numerical qualification. The complete resulting subset must independently pass the ARM/MPFR runner.

remaining: Two hard pow instruction streams still exceed Qfplib.
General pow totality outside the exact stage224 exponents remains unproved; final undecided trap retained.
Physical cache/timing and production integration await the final accepted platform/memory source, matching restore and explicit device handoff.
next_numeric_action: Profile and reduce the bounded integer midpoint power cost, considering a smaller certified enclosure before the unchanged stronger fallback.
cache_scope: 38 exact traces/19streams and four explicit warmed models.16 controls match. Three hard pow streams have small mixed/increased misses recorded in the report; near-one per-word fills add1.6misses/call. Physical speed is not inferred from models.
previous_full_million_scope: The full1003177-case run belongs to V86. V101 independently passes the complete75229 potentially affected subset, source equivalence/conditional enclosure proofs, and targeted direct/public ARM tests. No all-input totality or all-input speed bound is claimed.
